title: Warra Iddoo Biqiltuu Irraa Ari'aman
intro: Uumamni dhokataan tokko yeroo tokko sadarkaa uumama ol aanaa keessa jiraachaa ture, kan namoonni baay’een hubachuu danda’an caalaa Waaqummaatti dhihoo ture. Ta’us of tuuluun hidda gadi fageeffatee, gochi mormii tokko adeemsa jiraachuu jijjiire. Amma, uumamni kun hanga guyyaan abdachiifame gahutti akka diina kakateetti hasaasaa fi shira xaxaa jira. Eenyummaa isa kufe kanaa saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Yeroo tokko warra argama Waaqummaatti dhihoo ta’an keessaa tokko ture, uumama baay’ee caalaa ol ka’ee ture.
Ani lafa ykn suphee irraa osoo hin taane elementii gubaa irraan uumame.
Uumama haaraa duratti akkan jilbeenfadhu yeroon ajajamu, nan dide — waanan olaantummaa mataa kooti jedhee amanu irraa kan ka’e.
Na gatamee abaaramaa ture, dhumarratti garuu hanga yeroon beekamaa fi murtaa’etti yeroon akkan turu naaf kenname.
Kallattii hundaan sanyii Addaamitti dhiyaadheen hamman danda’e namoota hedduu dogoggorsuuf dhaadadhe.
Ani diina banaa, labsame dhala namaa hundaati, yeroo hunda hanga xumura muudameetti shira xaxaa fi hasaasudha.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
